newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks end up slightly in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks end up slightly in sluggish trade.

text.p: Shares on the Lima Stock Exchange made slight gains overall Tuesday in quiet trade as investors stayed on the sidelines awaiting economic news, brokers said.
They predicted a similar tendency for Wednesday.
According to preliminary figures, the bolsa's General Index .IGRA edged up 0.15 percent to 2,164.10 points while the blue-chip Selective Index gained 0.25 percent to 3,110.73.
"What we are seeing is a speculative week because there is no news to encourage a definite tendency with foundations," said Francisco Lopez, of Fortuna brokerage.

He said the only stocks to be recommended at the moment were Telefonica del Peru and brewery group Union de Cervecerias Backus, for their strong fundamentals, and miner Atacocha due to anticipated higher income.
Telefonica gained 1.48 percent to 6.87 soles Tuesday, while Backus was stable at 2.74 soles and Atacocha slipped 0.42 percent to 2.37 soles.
Eder Egusquiza, of Finanval brokerage, said investors should stay cautious due to the negative impact of Peru's internal politics and frictions with Ecuador on the disputed border.
